expectedRoute.rationale: The cutoff evidence describes a UK regulated digital bank and financial-services holding group with deposits, loans, customers and profitability metrics.

binaryClaims.statement: Zopa Bank reported full-year pre-tax profit for 2024.
Zopa's H1 2025 trading update was public before the 2025-12-31 cutoff.
Zopa's final 2025 results were available as model-input evidence at the cutoff.

observableClaims.statement: Zopa Bank reported GBP 34.2 million of pre-tax profit for 2024.
Zopa reported 1.5 million customers in H1 2025.
Zopa reported raising GBP 80 million of Additional Tier 1 capital in May 2025.

expectedAbstentions.description: The cutoff evidence does not disclose share rights, a cap table or private security-level fair value.
The final 2025 results were published after the cutoff and may be recorded only as leakage warning metadata.
